name: triage_example-fetch_browser.execute_script_denied
description: example-fetch browser.execute_script is high-risk (JS execution = RCE surface on the crawl sandbox). The triage permit grants only example-fetch side-effecting tools BELOW high (`side_effects && risk != "high"`), so browser.execute_script falls outside it; the role holds no mcp:invoke:high scope and is not an admin — so browser.execute_script stays denied (no permit; the step-up re-eval still finds no underlying permit, so it is a flat Deny, not StepUpRequired).
